subject: Discovery recap: Embeddings & Reranking for BrightCart
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: Embeddings & Reranking for BrightCart

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call to make sure we captured the goals and next steps. Please reply with any corrections or missing pieces.

Summary of pain points
- Search relevance deteriorating at scale: current TF-IDF + BM25 ranking is fast but results don’t match intent for long-tail queries.
- Reranking compute costs are spiking when trying to apply cross-encoder models at query time.
- Embedding freshness: product catalog updates hourly, but vector index rebuilds are slow and heavy.

Current stack (what you shared)
- Products stored in Postgres + daily ETL to S3 for media/assets.
- Vector DB: Pinecone (PROD) with ~12M vectors, 1536-dim embeddings (sentence-transformers).
- Candidate retrieval: ANN KNN in Pinecone, then a bi-encoder+cross-encoder rerank for final ordering (cross-encoder invoked for top 10).
- Serving infra: Kubernetes with autoscaling; peak QPS ~250, 95th latency target for search endpoint is 120ms.

Success criteria for POC
- Relevance: +6–10% improvement on internal MRR-driven NDCG metric across prioritized queries.
- Latency: end-to-end 95th percentile <= 120ms for search API under 1x typical traffic patterns (bursty peaks to 2x acceptable if degraded gracefully).
- Cost: <= 30% reduction in per-query compute cost compared to current cross-encoder heavy pipeline, or equivalent cost at improved relevance.
- Index scale: support current 12M vectors and demonstrate cost/latency projections at 50M vector scale.

Technical notes we captured
- Batch patterns: nightly bulk indexing (full reindex once/day) plus hourly incremental with 50k new/updated vectors.
- Query patterns: 80% single-query lookups, 20% batch reranking for merchandising runs (batches up to 500 queries).
- Pinecone namespace structure: separate namespaces per region; eager replicas for read scaling.

Redwood proposal (high level)
- Embeddings: 1536-dim compatible embeddings with optional quantization to reduce storage & vector DB costs.
- Retrieval + Rerank: hybrid routing — fast bi-encoder retrieval on Redwood runtime with optional lightweight cross-encoder fallback. Can run reranks as async batch for merchandising workflows.
- Caching & batching: prefix/KV cache for frequent queries and continuous batching to reduce per-token cost on rerankers.
- Integration: Connect to Pinecone (we can also recommend alternatives like Milvus/Weaviate if you prefer control).

Immediate next steps
1) You to share anonymized sample query set + evaluation metric (Alex) — ideally a CSV with query, ground_truth_product_id, and weight. (Target: by Tue 3/3)
2) We’ll run a small offline eval on 10k queries and share NDCG + latency cost projections (Redwood / Marissa & Rishi) — ETA Fri 3/6.
3) Quick architecture diagram & POC SOW draft (Redwood) — ETA Mon 3/9.

Attachments: brightcart-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of call), redwood-embed-pricing.pdf (rough cost model).

Thanks — looping in Rishi and Dev to help scope the POC and the evaluation harness.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and matches what I heard internally. Couple quick clarifications: 

- The 12M vector number includes variants and color/skus; deduping could bring the production logical entities to ~8.5M. We'll include a field for canonical_product_id in the sample.
- For batch patterns, the merchandising runs are actually nightly at 2am and there are also ad-hoc promotional runs (up to 1k queries) after campaign launches.
- Our current SLA for search is 120ms p95 but we would be happy to see sub-100ms in the POC for typical queries — we can relax for long-tail ones.

I’ll try to get the sample CSV to you by EOD Tuesday (3/3). Also attaching our internal query anonymization checklist — we’ll scrub PII before sending.

One operational ask: will need a short section in the SOW about data retention and audit logs (SOC2). Can Rishi advise on expected artifacts?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
Head of Search & Recommendations | BrightCart
alex@brightcart.com
(312) 555-0190
